primary_external_sources.name: CoinRun / Quantifying Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
primary_external_sources.finding: Generalization is measured on unseen procedurally generated levels; training-environment evaluation can hide overfitting.

primary_external_sources.name: Procgen Benchmark / train-procgen
primary_external_sources.finding: Train/test instances are separated by generator level ranges; unseen instances are explicit benchmark structure.

primary_external_sources.name: ProcgenOOD
primary_external_sources.finding: Unseen seeds under one generator distribution are distinct from OOD holdouts over generation features; the two axes must not be conflated.

primary_external_sources.name: DiscoGen / DiscoBench
primary_external_sources.finding: Benchmark methodology separates mutually exclusive meta-train/meta-test datasets and keeps the principal evaluation metric outside the mutable solution module.

strong_existing_controls: evaluator-only hidden state separated from SUT view
observed_f2_contract.unproven_property: No current WP800 field or observed test mechanically proves that a locked held-out fixture/case/family is disjoint from development or calibration fixtures at instance, generator-family, or declared feature-holdout level.
observed_f2_contract.why_holdout_set_id_is_insufficient: holdout_set_id is validated as an identifier and hashed into fixture identity, but source inspection found no accompanying manifest, generator contract digest, split-role semantics, or set-intersection check that establishes distributional independence.

cross_workpackage_signal.finding: A contemporaneous WP805 review independently identified that distinct opaque holdout_set_id values do not prove structural transfer disjointness when evidence_source_family, donor_path_family and method_family overlap.

hypothesis: WP800 should distinguish exact fixture integrity from held-out generalization validity by binding an explicit split/generator/holdout provenance contract.
counterhypothesis: The current harness may already be sufficient if fixture generation/freezing and pre-evaluation access are enforced by an external producer pipeline that mechanically guarantees disjointness; adding generator-family machinery inside WP800 would then duplicate authority.
next_exact_gate: Acquire E2_ARCHITECTURE_MAPPED, inspect all current WP800 producer paths and WP802-WP807 fixture usage, then determine whether split independence is already enforced externally or requires a minimal typed WP800 manifest contract.
